description: This file defines interfaces for controller-related functionalities in the WPEFramework, including system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata. It contains multiple interface structures with pure virtual methods, constants, and some documentation comments.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including start discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration management, including persisting configuration and retrieving or setting configuration for specific callsigns.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifetime management including activate, deactivate, suspend, resume, and notifications about plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing meta information about proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stacks.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts network discovery process using SSDP.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides results from SSDP network discovery.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the current configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets configuration for a specific callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin for lifetime notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin from lifetime notifications.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Puts a plugin into Hibernate state with optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details about currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin including configurations.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides details about active connections.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides information about framework process info, such as worker pools.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details of the active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version information including hash and human-readable form.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack information for a specific thread index.
